QuestInfo.name: [Arteria] Move Forward
QuestInfo.1: Your group has been split into two. Eckhart and Gaon will look for another way forward. Join the other #bCygnus Knights#k at the end of the #bBottom Deck Passage#k.
QuestInfo.2: You joined the Cygnus Knights and advanced together.
QuestInfo.0: Using Shinsoo's power, you were able to connect to the Empress's energy. You sense her faint voice coming from the top deck of the ship. Get up there and find her.

npc.0: We'll look for another way, #h0#. Go join the front line up ahead!
